items: Areas are bigger (about half as wide again, 168 m across) and fewer (14 by 14), so the forest is about the same size but each area has more room
Every area keeps an open fighting ground round its middle and its soundsystem: no trees and little undergrowth for 30 m, the woods thickening again beyond
Berry bushes and berries are as thick on the ground as before in the bigger areas
The ring round a party animal is split into one segment for each berry it needs; each berry it eats lights a segment
